steps.message:
## Diagnosis

The vendor screen's search funnels through `VendorDB.findVendors(String filter)` (`app/src/main/java/com/vrem/wifianalyzer/vendor/model/VendorDB.java`). It matched with two predicates:

- `StringContains` — matches the filter against the vendor name
- `MacContains` — matches the filter against that vendor's MAC prefixes (via `StringContains`)
